system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The secrets of Tao are found in a scroll in the Yamada clans storerooms. Manipulating Yin and Yang Chakra allows one to tap into a special form of energy called Tao. You’ve become able to sense the latent Tao within others. By Spending 1 minute focusing, for the next 10 minutes, creatures of your level and lower within 120 feet of you, that can mold Chakra or aren’t suppressing their chakra, reveal their presence to you. This does not reveal their location, only that they are within your sensory range and granting you immunity to being Surprised and hidden creatures cannot make attacks at advantage against you. Once you use this special sense, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.
